title: AAPL 最近一个月收盘价与20日均线（2026-10-06 至 2026-11-06）

method.code:
df = get_frame("dataset_e1b14122e9d6ee768b")
df = df.rename(columns=str.lower)
df['time'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time'])
df = df.sort_values('time').reset_index(drop=True)
df['ma20'] = df['close'].rolling(20).mean()
last20 = df.tail(20)
avg20 = round(float(last20['close'].mean()), 2)
last_row = df.iloc[-1]
cutoff = last_row['time'] - pd.Timedelta(days=31)
sub = df[df['time'] >= cutoff].copy()
sub['time'] = sub['time'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
rows = sub[['time','close','ma20']].to_dict('records')
rows = [{k: (round(v,2) if isinstance(v,(int,float)) else v) for k,v in r.items()} for r in rows]
result = {
 'rows': rows,
 'summary': {
   'avg_close_last20': avg20,
   'last20_start': last20['time'].iloc[0].strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
   'last20_end': last_row['time'].strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
   'last_close': round(float(last_row['close']),2),
   'last_ma20': round(float(last_row['ma20']),2),
   'chart_start': rows[0]['time'], 'chart_end': rows[-1]['time'],
   'chart_points': len(rows),
   'chart_missing': int(sub['close'].isna().sum() + sub['ma20'].isna().sum()),
   'ma20_leading_missing': int(df['ma20'].isna().sum()),
   'first_valid_ma20': df.loc[df['ma20'].notna(),'time'].iloc[0].strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
   'total_rows': int(len(df))
 }
}
